node.label: Poverty & inequality
node.summary: Poverty estimates, multidimensional poverty and inequality.

facts.text: NITI Aayog's national MPI paper (Jan 2024) said about **24.82 crore** people escaped multidimensional poverty between 2013-14 and 2022-23. The World Bank's extreme poverty line was revised to **$3.00/day** (2021 PPP) in 2025.
facts.plain: NITI Aayog's national MPI paper (Jan 2024) said about 24.82 crore people escaped multidimensional poverty between 2013-14 and 2022-23. The World Bank's extreme poverty line was revised to $3.00/day (2021 PPP) in 2025.

facts.text: World Bank: multidimensional poverty (OPHI MPI) fell from **53.8% (2005-06) to 16.4% (2019-21)**; the top 10% earn about **13 times** the bottom 10%; a belt from **U.P. to West Bengal** holds **57%** of India's poor; employment rose by about **134 million** in 2017-23, but youth unemployment rose from 14.6% to 15.9%.
facts.plain: World Bank: multidimensional poverty (OPHI MPI) fell from 53.8% (2005-06) to 16.4% (2019-21); the top 10% earn about 13 times the bottom 10%; a belt from U.P. to West Bengal holds 57% of India's poor; employment rose by about 134 million in 2017-23, but youth unemployment rose from 14.6% to 15.9%.

facts.text: **World Bank** Poverty and Equity Brief (Oct 2026): between 2011 and 2023 the share below the lower-middle-income line (**$4.20/day**) fell from **57.7% to 16.1%**, lifting **496 million** people; extreme poverty (**$3.00/day**) fell from **27.1% to 2.6%**.
